semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Fagor Automation Taiwan Co., Ltd. provides precision measurement and control equipment that can be utilized in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Fagor Automation Taiwan Co., Ltd. specializes in high-precision measurement and control solutions, including CNC numerical controllers and servo drive systems, which are essential for precision machinery in semiconductor applications. Their products support measurement and positioning tasks critical to semiconductor fabrication.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Fagor Automation Taiwan Co., Ltd. operates as a branch of the European MCC Group, serving a wide range of industries with a service network that spans over 50 countries.
